pages.title: Extreme Value Theory
pages.text: $(thing)Extreme Value Theory$()$(br2)The largest of many random draws follows its own law - and the rarest events are less rare than a bell curve says. Black swans happen.

$(thing)Insight$(): 130$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Distributions.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Normal Distribution Crystal, 1 Entropy Die.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Draw n numbers from a standard bell curve. Write the size m the largest of them typically has.
